criteria.criterion: introspection_for in crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs no longer requires run.events to be non-empty. It selects the earliest valid citation among the run's intervention events, observed host-error records and derived records, using a derived record's source intervention.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: introspection_for now calls introspection_sources. That function checks each event and each derived record on its own with validate_citations and maps each derived record to its source_intervention. It keeps only intervention rows that have a job and sorts them by (at, id). Observed host-error records are left out because they have no intervention row, which the accepted reading's assumptions allow. The `run.events.first()?` requirement is gone.

criteria.criterion: The D87 filter in run_on_from no longer has the `!r.events.is_empty()` restriction.
criteria.evidence: From the diff: the filter is now `.filter(|r| r.decision == "D87" && r.fired).find_map(|r| introspection_for(r, &headers, records, starts))`.

criteria.criterion: run_on_from pushes a Finding when a decision is in under_review and report.introspection is None, naming the decision.
criteria.evidence: From the diff: an else branch on `if let Some(record) = &introspection` pushes, for each decision in under_review, a Finding with condition "d" whose reason starts with "{decision} is under review but no introspection record could be built".

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli backtest`. A fixture whose records copy ar1x (the intervention and its derived host-error record) gives D87 under review, a Some(introspection) whose intervention is the source intervention, job and class of work match ar1x, and no findings.
criteria.evidence: The new test the_derived_record_of_ar1x_builds_the_introspection_from_its_source_intervention passed. It uses real_interventions, which copies the ar1x text, and asserts that D87 is under review, that intervention is AR1X, job is 20261013-192156-9h2j, class_of_work is "code", at is 2026-10-13T19:21:56Z, and there are no findings. The cited command passed, but its name filter matched no integration tests (backtest: 0 run, 21 filtered out). I ran the test through `--test backtest`, where it passed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli backtest`. A fixture where a decision is under review but no introspection can be built gives a finding naming that decision.
criteria.evidence: The test a_decision_under_review_with_no_introspection_is_a_finding_naming_it passed. Its fixture is an observed 405 host-error record with no intervention. It asserts that D87 is under review, introspection is None, and a condition-`d` finding contains "D87". The updated test a_host_error_record_of_the_405_... also passed with exactly that one finding.

criteria.criterion: Existing backtest tests still pass. `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
criteria.evidence: All 21 backtest integration tests passed. Every `test result` line in the full suite read ok with 0 failed. Clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check produced no output.

findings.summary: A changed file is outside the expected deliverables list.
findings.evidence: The deliverables list backtest.rs under src/, CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/defaults-loop.md. The change also edits tests/backtest.rs, adding two tests and updating the assertions of a_host_error_record_of_the_405_... to the new finding. The edit is needed and focused, since the existing fixtures live there, but the file is not on the list.

findings.summary: The verification command in the criteria does not run the new tests.
findings.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-cli backtest` filters by test name. The tests/backtest.rs binary reported 0 run and 21 filtered out. The new tests run only with `--test backtest` or with no filter.

findings.summary: earlier_cases is always empty by construction.
findings.evidence: `sources` is sorted by (at, id) and `first` is sources[0]. So `.skip(1).take_while(|e| (e.at, e.id) < (first.at, first.id))` can never yield anything, and check_introspection's loop over earlier_cases never runs. The code before the change had the same effect.

findings.summary: The missing-introspection finding fires only when no D87 introspection exists at all.
findings.evidence: The finding is in the else branch of the single D87 introspection. If D87 has a record and another decision were also under review, no finding would name that other decision. Today only D87 has an exact signal, so this cannot happen yet.

request_reading_mismatch: The reading said the tests would go in the in-file tests module of backtest.rs. They were added to crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs instead, which is where the existing backtest fixtures already live. The intent is unchanged.
summary: The change fixes the root cause. introspection_for now builds the record from the earliest valid citation among a fired D87 run's intervention events and its derived host-error records, using each derived record's source intervention. It no longer reads only run.events. run_on_from also adds a condition-`d` finding naming each decision under review when no introspection record was built. Two new tests cover this. One uses fixtures copying ar1x's intervention and its derived record: it builds the introspection from ar1x with job 20261013-192156-9h2j, class of work `code`, and no findings. The other puts a decision under review with no introspection and gets a finding naming D87. Both would fail on the base tree, where the derived-only path built nothing and produced no finding. I ran the backtest integration tests (21 passed), the full test suite, clippy with -D warnings, and fmt --check, and all were clean. There are only minor issues: the test file is not on the deliverables list, and the cited filter command `cargo test -p athena-cli backtest` runs none of the integration tests.
